headline: Nasdaq rallied about 0.8% on Anthropic IPO buzz and VIX fell 5%, though the dollar firmed against the yen.
brief: The Nasdaq Composite rose 0.8% to about 26,169, closing mid-range, as Anthropic IPO news revived the AI trade while the 10-year yield held near 5.00%. No BOJ decision or major China data falls in tonight's Asia session, so USD/JPY near 157.5 and positioning ahead of this week's FOMC, BOJ and mega-cap earnings are the main drivers. Key risk is a stronger dollar or rising yields fading the AI rally before the big events.

sources.title: Futures rise ahead of Big Tech earnings and Fed (TipRanks)
